# Hale's Heating & Cooling

> Locally owned HVAC service and installation company in Watkinsville, GA (Oconee County), serving residential and light commercial customers. Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer, NATE-certified technicians, BBB A+ rated. Georgia license GA CR110362.

- Phone: 706-765-7219
- Address: 1120 Mars Hill Road, Suite 106, Watkinsville, GA 30677
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Online booking: https://appointments.fieldedge.com/book/haleshvac
- Service area: Watkinsville, Athens, Bogart, Bishop, Statham, Winder, Monroe, Winterville, GA

## Services
- [AC & Heating Repair](https://www.haleshvac.com/repair/): Fast, accurate diagnosis and lasting repairs for air conditioners, heat pumps and furnaces.
- [New System Installation](https://www.haleshvac.com/installation/): Carrier Factory Authorized installs — properly sized AC, heat pump and furnace systems.
- [Maintenance & Tune-Ups](https://www.haleshvac.com/maintenance/): Seasonal tune-ups that cut breakdowns, lower bills and extend equipment life.
- [Indoor Air Quality](https://www.haleshvac.com/indoor-air-quality/): Filtration, humidity control and air purification for cleaner, healthier air.
- [Commercial HVAC](https://www.haleshvac.com/commercial-hvac/): Service, maintenance and replacement for offices, storage, retail and light commercial.
- [Emergency Service](https://www.haleshvac.com/emergency-hvac/): No heat or no cooling? We work to get you back up and running the same day.
- [Financing](https://www.haleshvac.com/financing/): Wells Fargo financing for Carrier systems, subject to credit approval.
